name: Temecula Promenade Mall
description: The Promenade at Temecula is a vibrant shopping destination located on Winchester Road, offering a diverse mix of retail stores, dining options, and services. This community-focused center serves the growing Temecula Valley area with convenient access to everyday shopping needs and popular national retailers. The open-air layout provides an inviting atmosphere for both locals and visitors exploring the heart of wine country.
summary: A community-focused open-air shopping center serving the Temecula Valley with diverse retail, dining, and service options.
